reason: The whole point is crew running in one room, but half my crew is on iPhone, so it can't actually work for us. For my own runs my Garmin already records GPS, pace, laps and heart rate better than a phone, and nothing here says it syncs with Garmin or Strava.
objection: Android only kills the crew feature for my group, and phone GPS plus virtual shoes and points I can't cash out feel like a game layered on top of data I already trust more on my watch.
would_change_my_mind: An iPhone version plus Garmin/Strava import, so my whole crew could join and my watch runs counted.
